headline: New Historic Low for Iranian Rial, Inflation at 66% in July
summary: The Iranian rial fell to new historic lows, intensifying pressure on an economy already strained by war and sanctions. Inflation stood at 66% in July.
why: The rial's exchange rate and inflation shape purchasing power, import costs and the risk of capital flight for Iran's economy and its trading partners.

impacts.name: Iranian rial
impacts.why: The rial hit a new historic low against major currencies, the direct subject of the report.
